findings.opportunity: Three refs track overlapping projection/selection state: selectedSourceId (id-change branch, lines 170/335-337), hasProjection (first-projection fit, lines 171/375-377), and previousSelection (fit on View/Change/Mode selection change, lines 175/353-356). They can collapse into one nullable ref: the stored value is always the previous run's full selection {id, change, effectiveMode}, so the id-change branch and the first-run fit can both be derived from it.
findings.impact: Removes 2 refs and 2 per-run bookkeeping assignments from the effect that hosts the anchor/fit regression the change fixed; one source of truth for 'previous selection' reduces the invariant surface future edits must keep in sync.
evidence: likec4/packages/diagram/src/likec4diagram/DiagramUI.tsx:353-356 (selectionChanged computed and ref written every ready run)
grep confirms selectedSourceId and hasProjection are referenced nowhere else in the package
findings.recommendation: Replace the three refs with one `previousSelection = useRef<{ id: string; change: string | null; mode: XirangViewMode } | null>(null)`. Compute `selectionChanged = previousSelection.current === null || previousSelection.current.id !== selected.id || previousSelection.current.change !== (selected.change ?? null) || previousSelection.current.mode !== effectiveMode` before mutation. Run the focus-reset branch only when `previousSelection.current !== null && previousSelection.current.id !== selected.id`. Send update.view with `initialProjection: selectionChanged` and delete the hasProjection ref entirely.
findings.keyDesign: One nullable ref holding the previous {id, change, effectiveMode}; `null` replaces `!hasProjection.current` for the first-projection fit, and the stored id replaces selectedSourceId for the id-change branch.
preservationConstraints: First projection after ready MUST still fit (null ref -> selectionChanged true)

Fit MUST fire only on id/effectiveMode/change selection change, never on focus drills or expand-in-place (initialProjection false path keeps the projectionViewportTransition viewport compensation with anchorIdentity: focusIdentity ?? null)

The id-change branch MUST still reset previousFocusAncestors and send navigate.focus to breadcrumbRoot when interactive and focus is null, and MUST be skipped on the first ready run (base selectedSourceId is initialized to the initial selected.id, so its branch never fires first)
The !isReady early return MUST NOT advance the merged ref, so the first ready run still fits
update.view MUST still be sent immediately on id change (no early return), preserving change-derived rendering when focusIdentity already equals the root
No changes to machine.setup.ts / machine.actions.ts (outside base scope) and no event-schema change
implementationOutline: Delete selectedSourceId and hasProjection refs; declare previousSelection as nullable
Compute selectionChanged before the focus-reset branch, reading the stored value
Gate the focus-reset branch on stored !== null && stored.id !== selected.id
Write previousSelection.current = { id: selected.id, change: selected.change ?? null, mode: effectiveMode } after the branch
Use initialProjection: selectionChanged and remove hasProjection.current = true
